  • Uses of ILiveLocatorContext in io.webagent4j.extraction

    Methods in io.webagent4j.extraction with parameters of type ILiveLocatorContext
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    <T> ExtractionResult<T>
    ExtractionEngine.extract(ILiveLocatorContext context, ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves request's source to one unambiguous element (ILocatorEngine.locateSingle(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)) and reads, converts, and validates its data.
    <T> ExtractionResult<List<T>>
    ExtractionEngine.extractList(ILiveLocatorContext context, ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves every element request's source matches (ILocatorEngine.locateAll(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)), reads, converts, and validates each one's data, and returns the results in DOM order (LocatorCandidate.domOrder()) - the deterministic order a caller asking for a whole collection expects, which is not necessarily the engine's internal rank order.
    ExtractionResult<ExtractedTable>
    ExtractionEngine.extractTable(ILiveLocatorContext context, LocatorDefinition source)
    Resolves source to one accessible HTML table (ILocatorEngine.locateSingle(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)) and reads its structure: headers from the table's own direct thead > tr > th/ thead > tr > td (empty when the table has no thead - never guessed from an untagged first row), and every direct tbody/tfoot/table-level tr not inside a thead, each row's cells read from its own direct th/td children in DOM order.
